verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing is a SaaS service that processes customer and payment data, so whether users can opt out of AI-model training is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI-training opt-out, a data-use policy, or any training-related privacy control. The sandbox, MCP and webhook items cover other capabilities and do not address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
